data.title: Model a vase from a measured profile
data.summary: A 0.30 m profile, 0.08 m rim diameter and 0.004 m intended wall. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: Blender supports editable curves, splines and curve modeling operations.

prerequisites: An authorized Blender / COLMAP / Nerfstudio environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: A 0.30 m profile, 0.08 m rim diameter and 0.004 m intended wall.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent turned vase workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: A 0.30 m profile, 0.08 m rim diameter and 0.004 m intended wall. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Draw a half-section curve in a consistent radial plane
Revolve it with Screw or a controlled lathe generator; close the bottom intentionally
Inspect a cut section and separate the outer silhouette from manufacturing thickness

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.
data.output: A versioned model a vase from a measured profile candidate, the input/parameter table, source identity and a review receipt with the checks below.
validation: The axis has no doubled vertices or open bottom
The profile matches the measured height and rim diameter
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: Wall thickness still needs process-specific manufacturing checks.
Sintra-authored proposal, not an executed Blender/engine/solver test. The diagram illustrates the procedure and is not a render or execution receipt.
Cloud chat cannot directly control a local 3D app without an appropriate authorized bridge. Tool access, model availability, paid services and rendering resources must be checked separately.
tips: Keep the profile editable rather than repeatedly sculpting the final mesh.
Let the LLM draft and explain bounded changes; use deterministic software to measure geometry, calculate trajectories and validate files.

data.prompt: Help me model a vase from a measured profile in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: A 0.30 m profile, 0.08 m rim diameter and 0.004 m intended wall. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: The axis has no doubled vertices or open bottom; The profile matches the measured height and rim diameter. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
